key_risks: Regulatory Non-Compliance & EU AI Act Fines: High-risk classifications may require strict auditability and logging.
Compounding Cascading Failure Rates: Multi-agent execution loops can significantly reduce end-to-end reliability.
Gross Margin Compression & Token Budget Explosions: Unbounded dynamic loops can increase token consumption and infrastructure costs.
Security & Indirect Prompt Injection: Unsanitized tool inputs can hijack agent intent and excessive IAM permissions increase attack surface.
key_takeaways: Architect for Compounding Error Mitigation: Enterprise adoption requires verification gates, recursion bounds, and Human-in-the-Loop controls.
Standardize on Open Inter-Agent Protocols: Vendor-neutral standards such as MCP can reduce single-cloud lock-in.
Transition to Value-Based / Consumption Hybrid Monetization: Pricing should better reflect actual multi-agent workload.
